plugins.Author: jFray
plugins.Name: EchoMix
plugins.Description: An interactive DJ deck with live mixing tools, custom playlists, and a synced listener mode with an audio visualizer.
plugins.Punchline: Spin tracks and let the party sync in.
plugins.Changelog: AudioHost now recovers automatically if it ever stops responding while still technically connected, instead of needing a manual restart.

plugins.Author: jFray
plugins.Name: EchoSim
plugins.Description: Simulates a full-length fight for your job using your own gear or a best-in-slot preset, then reports the DPS and shows exactly where it came from. Compares gear, melds and consumables, checks your openers and burst windows, and analyses an FFLogs report against the simulated ceiling. Kills on supported encounters can be scored and submitted to per-job leaderboards.
plugins.Punchline: Simulate your rotation, then see how your real kills measure up.
plugins.Changelog:
Fixed a stutter caused by EchoSim doing its heavy reading on the drawing thread - building a job's ceiling, and reading the meld list, now happen in the background.

EchoSim now answers to /es as well as /echosim.

plugins.Author: jFray
plugins.Name: EchoNav
plugins.Description: Lists the Critical Encounters and FATEs running in Occult Crescent: North Horn and walks you to any of them with a single click, choosing between walking, an aetheryte hop and Occult Return. Also tracks the pot cycle, keeps your knowledge-crystal buffs topped up, and can step around monsters and pick up coffers on the way. Does nothing outside North Horn.
plugins.Punchline: See what's up in North Horn, then click once to get there.
plugins.Changelog:
The aetheryte network now works whatever language you play in. Playing in anything but English, no shard was ever found and EchoNav quietly walked everywhere instead.
Travelling to a shard you have never stood at yourself now works. It used to need you to have visited a shard before it could take you there.
The window no longer appears on the title and character select screens.

plugins.Author: jFray
plugins.Name: EchoGlam
plugins.Description: Dress your character in any item in the game from a searchable in-game wardrobe, dye every slot, edit full appearance and save named outfits. Then publish the look to a community catalogue you can browse, filter, vote on and favourite without leaving the game - and put anyone else's glamour on with one click, with a revert that is always one click away. No other plugins required.
plugins.Punchline: Build a glamour, share it, and wear anyone else's.
plugins.Changelog:
Added Friends. Turn on Glamour Sharing, then right-click somebody in game and choose Add EchoGlam Friend.
Friends see the glamours you wear, and you see theirs. Nobody else does, and nothing about you is shared until you turn it on.
Outfit changes show on your friends' screens as you make them, along with the appearance you are wearing.
An outfit's swap animation plays on their screen too, at the same moment it plays on yours.
Hide a friend's glamours without unfriending them, from their row in the Friends tab.
Turning sharing off stops anyone looking you up, and keeps your friends.
/eg opens EchoGlam, the same as /echoglam.

plugins.Author: jFray
plugins.Name: EchoRoleplay
plugins.Description: Write a full roleplay profile for your character - name, appearance, backstory, hooks and rumours - and read anyone else's by hovering them. Set statuses that hang under your character for others to read at a glance, and keep private notes on everyone you have met.
plugins.Punchline: A roleplay profile for your character, readable at a glance.
plugins.Changelog:
You can now open the plugin with /erp (haha) as well as /echorp.
Fixed the window opening as a small box with unreadable text after an update, with no way to expand it.
